issues.problem: « Soient l une équation de H … le groupe des translations de H » implicitly asserts that the affine structure on H does not depend on the equation. Only the kernels are proved equal; the actions of HemiTrans l and HemiTrans (c • l) are not compared. SCOPE discloses this ('equal only propositionally'), but nothing proves it. It is the one implicit assertion of the marked block without a counterpart

fidelity_summary: Déf. 6 is formalized faithfully. The translation space is L(E/N, N) = (E ⧸ ker l) →ₗ ker l, the action is the printed formula, its independence of the representative is proved for every representative, and the action is simply transitive on every open hemisphere (Déf. 1 as printed) and an AddTorsor when l ≠ 0 (DEC-114). Nothing is vacuous or definitional. The p. 236 sentence (an open hemisphere of S(n) ≅ ℝⁿ) is proved. The mark is earned. The only uncertified implicit content is the independence of the equation l at the level of the action (minor).
